note: Hand-curated from City of Glendale notices and local news. Percentages are system-wide averages; each customer class gets a different increase. 'proposed' steps are not final until adopted.

electric.detail: First step of the 2023 cost-of-service plan. Residential bills rose about 18.7%.
The third 11.3% step (planned for July 2025) was delayed and split over three years to fund Grayson, Scholl Canyon and solar work without breaking bond covenants.
Second part of the split 11.3% step.
Final part of the split 11.3% step.

water.detail: Rates from the 2018 water rate study. Staff report: water rates rose 7.5% total from 2019 to 2026 while inflation was 29.2%.
Total of increases 2019–2026 (individual steps not itemized here).
Council adopted a water infrastructure plan in Sept 2026. About +$37/month for an average single-family home. Needs the Prop 218 notice and hearing process first; community meetings start Oct 7.

storage.name: Grayson Repowering Project
storage.status_note: Tesla Megapack battery plus five Wärtsilä gas engines. GWP targeted operation for summer 2026; in May 2025 the battery island was 29% complete and tariffs on batteries from China could add about $75–82 million.
